title: Dynamics Among Borderline Personality and Anxiety Features in Psychotherapy Outpatients: An Exploration of Nomothetic and Idiographic Patterns
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited scope of symptoms measured (only 3 BPD and 3 anxiety symptoms); - 2-hour interval between observations may miss rapid dynamics; - GIMME assumes weak stationarity, which may be violated in active treatment; - Self-report only, no objective measures.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. Code for GIMME is available via the R package 'gimme' (Lane et al., 2018), but the dataset is not publicly available. The authors mention that the data were collected for a larger study, but no public repository or link is provided.
